method: Fixed Git objects and exact Rust snapshots reviewed; rustfmt parser and Python byte/declaration checks only. No Cargo, rustc, Go, Rust/Windows/game/desktop execution.

mappings.scope: Post-attachment root/descendant cleanup and cancellation. New self-hosted helper requires a stdin byte written only after Job attachment before spawning its descendant. Deny-delete fixture file remains held while that descendant runs. This does not prove containment before attachment.

Wait and mandatory cleanup on all ordinary outcomes. Go runtime goroutines and Rust OS threads are different: Rust is_finished+join proves pipe workers are finished, independent of wake messages and root status.

mappings.go: internal/luals/runtime.go:Runtime.Check bounded context and runGuarded error projection
mappings.scope: Preserve selected stop cause and original invocation ancestry; no new operation timeout after completion. Exact Source engine output/CLI parity is not claimed by these lifecycle fixtures.

extensions.contract: A root exit with closed pipes cannot permit success while the exact attached Job still contains descendants.
Output caps and I/O faults are distinct; stdin failure with exit zero is an error with terminal evidence, while nonzero status remains available to the caller.

ci.command: node tools/rust-cargo.mjs --owner ci-source-process --one-shot -- test --locked --offline -p lycheedev-source --lib process::tests -j 1
ci.staticInclusion: new module is process::tests::lifetime_tests; recursive rustfmt resolved it

notCovered: Actual thread-creation resource exhaustion; checked Builder::spawn failure path reviewed but not fault-injected.
Real wait, Job query, terminate and kill failures use the production retirement algorithm with modeled owner results; no OS fault injection executed.
A hard realtime OS bound is not claimed: std is_finished permits non-blocking join, but documentation notes a brief thread teardown interval.
JobGuard and standard Child/pipe/thread handle closure is Drop-only, not checked CloseHandle.
No pre-attachment descendant containment: the existing running spawn/attach race remains.
Legacy luac None entry may still remove its Frozen scratch on unconfirmed errors; its ordered entry remains conservative.
Separate existing five-second error cleanup grace can extend beyond the original operation deadline; only success uses the original deadline.
